Tier Novice

Check Thievery vs. mark's Perception DC (Steal)

Effect a Perception check to notice takes a status penalty equal to your Deception proficiency rank (+2 trained, +4 expert, +6 master, +8 legendary)

Pick a pocket, plant an item, or swap a sealed cargo tag while holding unbroken eye contact and small talk. Roll Thievery against the mark's Perception DC as normal to Steal — nobody watches hands when the face is talking, and the mark's own attentiveness is working against them.

cinderfall.incomplete: The penalty targets an observer's Perception check, scaled by the actor's unrelated Deception rank. No selector exists in pf2e for an external creature's check, scaled by this actor's proficiency in a different skill (distracting-feint.json/effect-distracting-feint.json two-file gap for the external-target part; no cross-skill-rank selector precedent found either).
